_comment: The ONLY place a spoken respelling may happen. Captions and transcripts are always built from the display text; this table changes what the voice says and nothing else. Every entry must be a respelling of the same words, because validate_narration.py checks that the cue words equal the display words exactly. Per-slide `speak` overrides are NOT part of the schema: this table is the single respelling mechanism, so validation stays deterministic.
voice_note: Applied case-sensitively, longest phrase first, ignoring surrounding punctuation.
